description: Delete intersections. Give the name of an intersection set to delete that set. If no intersection set is given then all intersections are deleted. Empty intersection sets are also deleted.
notes: The manuals give the set as 'intersection-set <s>'; the engine rejects that keyword ('Unused extra parameter') and takes the name directly: fracture intersections delete 'name' (PFC 6.00, 7.00 and 9.8, FLAC3D 9.8, 3DEC 9.8). The rejected form has already deleted all intersection sets when the error is reported (seen on PFC 6.00 and 3DEC 9.8).
